blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Self-supervised learning draws inspiration from infant visual development, yet standard training pipelines bear little resemblance to it: images are independently sampled and globally shuffled across epochs.
We study self-supervised learning from continuous video streams, where frames are consumed in temporal order using strict sliding-window batches, without global reshuffling or multi-epoch replay. To this end, we construct WT++ , a 95-hour urban walking-tour video dataset for streaming pretraining. Combined with a comprehensive evaluation suite
we find that contrastive and distillation-based methods struggle in this setting, while MAE is more robust but still falls short of standard i.i.d. pretraining. We find that high inter -batch similarity, caused by sliding-window consumption across consecutive batches, does not explain this gap. The main challenge is high intra -batch similarity, where frames within each batch are near-duplicates. To mitigate this, we propose StreamMAE, which preserves the core MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the input pipeline with stream-aware regularization and motion-biased crop selection. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, matches i.i.d. MAE trained on the same video data, remains competitive with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, and scales positively as the pretraining stream grows from 12 to 95 hours.
blocks.zh:
自我监督的学习从婴儿的视觉发育中汲取灵感,然而标准的培训管道却与它没有什么相似之处:图像是独立取样的,并且在全球各个时代都摇摆不定.
我们研究从连续的视频流中进行自我监督的学习,在视频流中,帧按时间顺序消耗,使用严格的滑动窗口批量,而不进行全球重排或多时代重播. 为此,我们建造了WT++,一个95小时的城市步行-旅游视频数据集,用于溪流预训. 与综合评价套间合并
我们发现这种反差和蒸馏方法 在这个环境中挣扎, 而MAE更强健,但仍低于标准 即预训。 我们发现,由于连续几批次的窗面滑动消费导致的高度间隙相似性并不能解释这一差距。 主要的挑战是批次内部的相似性很高,每批次的帧几乎都是重复的。 为了缓解这种情况,我们提议StreamMAE, 保留了StreamMAE的核心重建目标,同时使投入管道适应于溪流感官化和有运动偏见的作物选择。 StreamMAE的绩效超过了流线基线,匹配了同一视频数据培训的MAE,与ImageNet预先培训的MAE依然具有竞争力,随着预训流从12小时增长到95小时,规模也呈正比.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) methods, such as MAE [ 26 ] and DINO [ 5 , 37 ] , have advanced visual representation learning. These models are trained on large image collections [ 15 , 42 , 37 ] that are shuffled, often revisited over multiple epochs, and sampled to form diverse batches. This approximates an independent-and-identically-distributed (i.i.d.) regime at the batch level: batches contain diverse, unrelated examples, supporting stable optimization and broad coverage. While SSL is often motivated by how infants and animals learn without explicit high-level supervision, such as language, this pretraining regime remains far from how visual experience arrives in practice.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习(SSL)方法,如MAE[26]和DINO[5,37],都有先进的视觉表现学习. 这些模型都接受了大图像集[15,42,37]的培训,这些图像集被洗涤,常常在多个纪元上重新审视,并进行取样以形成不同的批次. 这大致相当于在批量一级实行独立和相同分配的(即d.)制度:批量包含不同、无关的例子,支持稳定优化和广泛覆盖。 虽然SSL的动机往往是婴儿和动物在没有语言等明确高级别监督的情况下学习,但这种预训制度仍然远远没有实际的视觉经验。

blocks.en: Natural visual experience is inherently sequential. A camera, robot, or embodied agent observes the world as a temporally ordered stream, where consecutive frames are highly similar and visual content evolves slowly over time. This setting removes a central convenience of standard gradient-based SSL: the ability to globally shuffle data and construct diverse batches. We therefore ask: Can SSL work well on continuous video streams and scale with more video data when trained from random initialization, without global shuffling, multi-epoch training, or a long-term replay buffer?
blocks.zh: 自然视觉体验本质上是连续的. 相机,机器人,或化身的代理观测世界为时序流,连续帧高度相似,视觉内容随时间推移而缓慢演化. 这种设置消除了基于标准梯度的SSL的中心方便性:全球洗涤数据和构建不同批次的能力. 因此,我们问:如果通过随机初始化培训,没有全局的洗涤,多时代的训练,或者长期的重播缓冲器,SSL在连续的视频流和规模上能够发挥良好的作用吗?

blocks.en: Learning from streaming video is appealing not only as a fundamental research question, but also for embodied agents and edge devices, where data naturally arrive sequentially and need not be stored as a fixed training dataset. However, this regime challenges standard gradient-based training: instead of diverse batches that approximate the data distribution, streaming batches come from short consecutive video segments, are highly redundant, and often contain only small visual changes. As a result, SSL methods that work well on large image collections may not be the best fit for continuous video.
blocks.zh: 从流媒体中学习视频不仅作为一个基本研究问题具有吸引力,而且对于体现的物剂和边缘设备也具有吸引力,因为数据自然按顺序运抵,不需要作为固定的培训数据集存储。 然而,这种制度对基于梯度的标准培训提出了挑战:流媒体批次不是来自数据分布的大致不同的批次,而是来自短时间连续的视频段,非常冗余,往往只包含小的视觉变化. 因此,在大型图像收藏上效果良好的SSL方法可能并不最适合连续视频.

blocks.en: Several recent works study learning from continuous video, but typically relax the strict from-scratch streaming setting: they focus on online prediction or adaptation with pretrained initialization [ 6 ] , address correlated updates without fully closing the from-scratch degradation [ 22 ] , or use replay buffers to restore batch diversity [ 56 ] . In contrast, we study SSL from scratch: models consume video in temporal order using sliding-window batches and are trained without long-term replay buffers.
blocks.zh: 近期的几部作品研究从连续视频中学习,但通常放松严格的从剪切流线设置:它们注重在线预测或通过预先训练的初始化进行适应[6],在不完全关闭剪切降解[22]的情况下处理相关更新,或使用重播缓冲器恢复批量多样性[56]. 相比之下,我们从零开始研究SSL:模型使用滑动窗口批量按时间顺序消耗视频,并经过训练,没有长期的重播缓冲器.

blocks.en: To study this setting, we extend the released WalkingTours (WT) dataset [ 49 ] into WT++ , a 95-hour collection of walking-tour videos for streaming pretraining. We evaluate learned representations across several downstream vision tasks, covering both close-to-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了研究这个设置,我们把发布的WalkingTours(WT)数据集[49]扩展为WT++,这是一个95小时的步行图视频集,用于流传预训. 我们评价若干下游远景任务中汲取的教训,包括近域基准和域外基准。

blocks.en: We first benchmark common SSL objectives under this streaming setup, including contrastive learning with MoCo v3 [ 10 ] , self-distillation with DINO [ 5 ] , and masked reconstruction with MAE [ 26 ] . Under streaming pretraining, MoCo v3 and DINO lag behind MAE (see Figure 1 , right), making masked reconstruction the strongest starting point in our setting. However, streaming MAE still falls short of standard i.i.d. MAE trained on the same visual data. We investigate this gap by separating two effects: inter-batch similarity , i.e., similarity between consecutive batches caused by fixed-order sliding-window consumption, and intra-batch similarity , i.e., similarity among examples within the same batch. To isolate these effects, we pre-shuffle ImageNet-1K [ 15 ] once and then consume it as a fixed stream. MAE trained on this pre-shuffled stream matches standard i.i.d. MAE, showing that inter-batch similarity alone does not explain the gap. The main difficulty instead comes from high intra-batch similarity in continuous video, where each batch contains many near-duplicate frames.
blocks.zh: 我们在这个流派设置下第一个共同的基准SSL目标,包括与MoCo v3 [10] 的对比性学习,与DINO [5] 的自我消化,与MAE [26] 的遮掩重建. 在溪流预训下,MoCo v3和DINO落后于MAE(见图1,右),使得蒙面重建成为我们设定中最强的起点. 然而,流传的MAE仍低于同一视觉数据培训的标准即MAE. 我们通过区分两种效果来调查这一差距:间隙相似性,即由固定顺序滑窗消费导致的连续批次之间的相似性,与间隙相似性,即同一批次内实例之间的相似性. 为了隔离这些效果,我们先将ImageNet-1K(英语:ImageNet-1K [15])一次并消耗为固定流. MAE训练了这个预排的流 符合标准 i. d. MAE,仅显示批次间相似性并不能解释差距. 相反,主要困难来自连续视频中的高空内框相似性,每批中包含许多近似重复的帧.

blocks.en: Motivated by this analysis, we propose StreamMAE, a simple adaptation of MAE for streaming video. As summarized in Figure 1 , StreamMAE preserves the MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the training pipeline to reduce the effect of temporally redundant batches. It combines stronger regularization, two-stage cropping, and motion-biased crop selection based on patch-level frame differences. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, narrows the gap to standard i.i.d. MAE on the same video data, and scales with encoder capacity and pretraining duration ( Figure 1 , bottom right). These results suggest that masked reconstruction, combined with stream-aware sampling and regularization, is a strong foundation for self-supervised learning from continuous video streams.
blocks.zh: 基于这一分析,我们提出 StreamMAE, 简单改编MAE 用于流视频。 如图1所示,StreamMAE保留了MAE重建目标,同时调整了培训管道,以减少时间上多余批次的影响。 它结合了更强的规范化,两阶段的种植,以及基于补丁级框架差异的运动偏差的作物选择. StreamMAE的表现超过了流线基线,将差距缩小到标准即d. 同一视频数据的MAE,以及具有编码能力和预训时间的尺度(图1,右下方). 这些结果表明,蒙面重建,加上溪流感光采样和规范化,是从连续视频流中自我监督学习的坚实基础.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Left: StreamMAE adapts MAE to continuous video streams with stream-aware regularization and crop selection. Right: StreamMAE (ViT-S) improves dense performance over streaming SSL baselines (top) and improves with longer pretraining streams and a larger backbone (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图1:左:StreamMAE将MAE适应连续的视频流,具有流感常态和作物选择. 右:流线MAE(ViT-S)比流线SSL基线(顶部)提高了密度性能,并随着较长的预训流和更大的骨干(底部)而改进.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Self-supervised image encoders. Self-supervised image encoders have become standard backbones for vision tasks, transferring well to classification, segmentation, depth estimation, 3D geometry, and other downstream tasks [ 54 , 37 , 53 ] . They are trained with a range of objectives. Contrastive methods, such as MoCo [ 27 , 8 , 10 ] , learn by contrasting different image views. Self-distillation methods, such as DINO and DINOv2 [ 5 , 37 ] , align student and teacher representations. Masked modeling methods, such as MAE [ 26 ] , I-JEPA [ 4 ] , and CAPI [ 14 ] , learn from partially observed images by reconstructing pixels or predicting representations. Some works also train image encoders from video, often using temporal information through ordering or motion [ 44 , 45 ] , or by reconstructing future patches [ 20 ] . Closely related to our data source, Venkataramanan et al. [49] and Han et al. [21] study SSL of image encoders from walking-tour videos. Despite their success, these methods are typically developed under i.i.d.-style pretraining on large image collections or offline video datasets, where samples can be shuffled and batches contain diverse examples. We instead study how standard image SSL objectives behave on continuous video streams with high intra-batch similarity.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的图像编码器. 自我监督的图像编码器已经成为视觉任务的标准主干,向分类,分化,深度估计,3D几何等下游任务转移良好[54,37,53]. 他们接受培训时有一系列目标。 对比方法,如MoCo[27,8,10],通过对比不同的图像观点来学习. 自我消化方法,如DINO和DINov2[5,37],使学生和教师的表述一致. 蒙面造型方法,如MAE [26],I-JEPA [4],以及CAPI [14],通过重建像素或预测表示来从部分观测到的图像中学习. 一些作品还从视频中训练图像编码器,经常通过订购或运动[44,45],或通过重建未来补丁[20]来使用时间信息. 与我们的数据来源Venkataramanan等人密切相关。 [49] (中文(简体) ). [21]从行走的视频中研究图像编码器的SSL. 尽管这些方法取得了成功,但这些方法一般是在大图像集或离线视频数据集的即时预训下开发的,其中样本可以洗涤,批次中包含各种实例. 相反,我们研究标准图像SSL目标如何在连续的视频流中表现得与批内相似。

blocks.en: Learning from streaming video. Video SSL has also been studied with explicitly temporal objectives, including temporal ordering [ 36 ] , predictive coding [ 23 ] , and masked video modeling [ 48 , 51 ] . However, most video SSL methods still assume offline access to videos, where clips can be sampled randomly, shuffled into batches, and revisited over multiple epochs. In contrast, we keep the encoder image-based and study a streaming setting in which frames are consumed in temporal order.
blocks.zh: 学习流媒体视频. 对视频SSL的研究也具有明确的时间目标,包括时间订购[36],预测编码[23],蒙面视频模型[48,51]. 然而,大多数视频SSL方法仍然假定视频的离线访问权,其中片段可以随机抽取,分批抽取,并在多个纪元上重新审视. 与此相对照,我们保持编码器的图像为基础,并研究一个流线设置,其中帧按时间顺序消耗.

blocks.en:
While several methods study continual SSL [ 17 , 29 ] or online learning from images [ 24 , 25 ] , only a few works consider self-supervised learning from continuous video streams directly. Prior methods often mitigate temporal correlation through replay or memory mechanisms, including infinite or minimum-redundancy replay buffers [ 58 , 40 ] and reservoir-based [ 50 ] memory over temporally segmented videos [ 56 ] .
Relatedly, Mall and Henriques [34] study supervised continual video classification using a rolling replay buffer of compressed video codes. Carreira et al. [6] study online learning from a single continuous stream, but focuses on online prediction and adaptation, with its strongest setups relying on ImageNet [ 15 ] initialization. Wang et al. [52] use masked reconstruction to adapt a task-trained model during deployment, making their approach complementary to our pretraining setting.
Closest to our work, Han et al. [22] target correlated gradient updates, but training from scratch remains substantially below settings initialized from pretrained models. In contrast, we study from-scratch representation learning from ordered video streams and adapt MAE through streaming-aware regularization and crop selection, without relying on long-term replay buffers.
blocks.zh:
虽然有几种方法研究持续SSL[17,29]或在线学习图像[24,25],但只有少数作品认为直接从连续视频流中进行自我监督学习. 先前的方法往往通过重播或内存机制来缓解时间相关性,包括无限或最小重播缓冲[58,40]和基于库的[50]内存超过时间分解的视频[56].
与此相关的是,Mall和Henriques[34]研究利用压缩视频代码的滚动回放缓冲器监督持续视频分类。 Carreira 等人著. [6] 研究单一连续流的在线学习,但侧重于在线预测和适应,其最强的设置依赖于ImageNet[15]初始化. 王等编. [52] 使用蒙面重建,在部署期间采用任务训练模式,使其方法与我们的培训前环境相辅相成。
最贴近我们的工作,韩等. [22] 目标相关梯度更新,但从零开始的培训仍然大大低于从预先训练过的模型初始化的设置。 对比之下,我们从scratch代表学习从订购的视频流中学习,并通过流感常态化和作物选择来适应MAE,而不依赖长期的重播缓冲.

blocks.en: 3 Learning from a Streaming Video
blocks.zh: 3 从流媒体中学习

blocks.zh: 3.1 流线滑-温道管

blocks.en: We assume access to a batch of examples at each training step, since learning from a single frame at a time would impose an overly restrictive setting. This setup differs from standard i.i.d. training, where samples are shuffled and batches are formed without preserving temporal structure. blocks.en: 3.2 WT++ Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.2 WT++ 数据集

blocks.en: We train models on urban-scene walking-tour videos, following Venkataramanan et al. [49] and the released WalkingTours (WT) dataset. WT consists of long, single-shot videos recorded while a person walks through different cities. These videos contain diverse objects, lighting conditions, viewpoints, and scene transitions, making them a natural testbed for studying learning from video streams.
blocks.zh: 我们用城市-场景步行的视频训练模特儿, [49]和发布的WalkingTours(WT)数据集. WT由长片,单镜头录制的视频组成,在一个人穿越不同城市时录制. 这些视频包含各种物品,照明条件,观点,以及场景过渡,使其成为学习视频流的自然试验台.

blocks.en:
The WT dataset contains approximately 13 hours of video, which limits larger-scale streaming experiments. We therefore extend it and construct WT++ , a 95-hour dataset comprising 58 public walking-tour videos. WT++ includes all videos from the original WT dataset [ 49 ] , except for the Wildlife safari video.
Details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
WT数据集包含大约13小时的视频,这限制了更大的流线实验. 因此,我们扩大范围并建造WT++,这是一个95小时的数据集,由58个公共步行视频组成。 WT++包括来自WT原始数据集的所有视频[49],除了野生动物猎人视频.
详情见附录C。

blocks.en: By default, models are trained on a single 12-hour video, WT++London (i.e., WT++12h ). For larger-scale experiments, we concatenate multiple walking-tour videos into one ordered stream and train with the same streaming protocol. This approximates a long continuous stream, since publicly available single-shot walking-tour videos rarely span tens of hours. The stream remains temporally ordered within each video with discontinuities at video boundaries.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下,模型通过单12小时视频WT++伦敦(即WT++12h)进行训练. 为了进行更大规模的实验, 我们把多段步行图视频 装入一个订购的溪流 并用同样的流线协议进行训练。 这大概是一个长的连续流,因为公开的单拍步行图视频很少持续数十小时。 每一段录像中仍按时间顺序排列,视频边界不连续。

blocks.en:
To illustrate the temporal structure of the data, we analyze frame similarity in WT++London using DINOv2 [ 37 ] features. We compare pairwise cosine similarities for 512 consecutive frames sampled from a local stream window against 512 frames sampled uniformly at random from the same video.
As shown in Figure 3 , consecutive 15 FPS frames can be highly similar, whereas randomly sampled frames are substantially more diverse. This illustrates the distributional gap between streaming and shuffled batches, and motivates methods that can learn from temporally local, correlated data.
blocks.zh:
为了说明数据的时间结构,我们利用DINOv2[37]特性分析WT++伦敦的帧相似性. 我们比较了从本地流线窗口抽取的512个连续帧的对偶余弦相似性,与从同一视频中随机抽取的512个帧的对偶余弦相似性。
如图3所示,连续15个FPS帧可以高度相似,而随机抽样的帧则大为多样化. 这说明了流体和洗涤批次之间的分布差距,并激励了能够从时间上本地相关数据中学习的方法。

blocks.en: 4 Towards StreamMAE
blocks.zh: 页:1 走向流媒体

blocks.en: Our goal is to design a self-supervised method that can learn from continuous video streams. As suggested by Figure 1 , MAE is more robust under streaming pretraining than MoCo v3 [ 10 ] and DINO [ 5 ] . This is consistent with the nature of their objectives: masked reconstruction operates on each example independently, avoiding the need to contrast examples within similar batches [ 10 ] or to cluster visual concepts across a diverse pretraining corpus [ 5 ] - both of which become problematic when the data stream is temporally correlated. We therefore build on MAE and use standard i.i.d. sampled pretraining on the same visual data as a reference throughout this work.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是设计一种能够从连续视频流中学习的自我监督的方法. 如图1所示,MAE在溪流预训下比MOCo v3 [10] 和DINO [5]更强壮. 这与其目标的性质是一致的:蒙面重建在每一个实例上独立运作,避免了在类似批次中对比实例[10]或将视觉概念组合成一个不同的预训体[5] -- -- 当数据流在时间上相互关联时,这两种概念都会成为问题。 因此,我们以MAE为基础,在这项工作的整个过程中,将同一视觉数据上的抽样预训标准作为参考。

blocks.en: However, streaming MAE still falls short of this i.i.d. reference ( cf . Figure 1 ), and the gap becomes substantial when scaling to ViT-B/16, underperforming by nearly 10 mIoU points on Cityscapes ( cf . Table 4 ). To understand this gap, we identify two key departures from standard i.i.d. pretraining. The first is inter-batch similarity : in streaming training, the fixed-order sliding-window consumption means that consecutive batches share most of their examples, leading to highly correlated gradient updates across successive optimization steps. The second is intra-batch similarity : because each batch is drawn from a local temporal window of the video stream, the examples within a single batch can be near-duplicate frames depicting the same scene with only minor visual variations.
blocks.zh: 然而,流转的MAE仍未达到这一参考值(参见图1),在ViT-B/16上缩放时,差距就变得很大,城市景观上表现差10 mIoU点(参见表4)。 为了理解这一差距,我们确定了两个关键偏离标准,即预训。 第一个是批次间的相似性:在流线训练中,固定顺序的滑窗消耗意味着连续批次分享它们的大部分实例,从而在连续的优化步骤中产生高度相关的梯度更新。 二是批内相似性 : 由于每批都是从视频流的局部时间窗口中抽取的,所以单批内的例子可以是近似复制框,仅以微小的视觉变化来描绘同一场景.

blocks.en: To disentangle these two factors, we construct a controlled experiment. We pre-shuffle ImageNet-1K once and treat the resulting sequence as a fixed stream, forming batches with a sliding window of stride s = 8 s=8 . This retains the fixed-order sliding-window consumption of the streaming protocol, and therefore high inter-batch similarity, while removing the near-duplicate frames that characterize video-stream batches, yielding low intra-batch similarity. For each setting (IN-1K-i.i.d., IN-1K pre-shuffled+streaming, and our WT++12h ), we draw consecutive batches of frames and measure inter-batch and intra-batch cosine similarity using features from a pretrained DINOv2 [ 37 ] model: μ inter \mu_{\mathrm{inter}} , μ intra \mu_{\mathrm{intra}} (details in the Appendix E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了分解这两个因素,我们构建了一个有控制的实验. 我们先将图像Net-1K预洗一次,然后将产生的序列作为固定流处理,以滑动的窗口s=8s=8组成批次. 这保留了串流协议的固定顺序的滑窗消耗,因此,批次间相似度较高,同时移除了视频串流批次特征的近重复帧,产生低批次内相似度. 对于每个设置(IN-1K-i.d.,IN-1K 预先洗牌+流化,以及我们的WT++12h),我们利用预先训练的DINOv2 [37] 型号的特性,绘制连续批次的帧和量子间和秒内同位素相似性:μ inter\mu_{\mathrm{inter}},μ unit\mu_{\mathrm{intra}}(附录E.1中的细节).

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , the three settings span a spectrum. The IN-1K i.i.d. setting exhibits low similarity on both metrics, as expected from random sampling over a diverse dataset. The WT++12h stream yields substantially higher values for both: μ intra = 0.665 \mu_{\mathrm{intra}}=0.665 reflects high visual similarity within each temporal window, and μ inter = 1.000 \mu_{\mathrm{inter}}=1.000 reflects nearly complete overlap between successive sliding-window batches. Crucially, the IN-1K pre-shuffled streaming setting occupies an informative middle ground: it nearly matches the WT++12h stream in inter-batch similarity ( μ inter = 0.989 \mu_{\mathrm{inter}}=0.989 ) due to the same sliding-window mechanics, but retains the low intra-batch similarity of i.i.d. training ( μ intra = 0.004 \mu_{\mathrm{intra}}=0.004 ) because the underlying images are diverse. This decoupled setting allows us to isolate the effect of each factor, which we investigate next.

blocks.en: 4.2 Regularization under High Intra-Batch Similarity
blocks.zh: 4.2 在 " 高度内置 " 下进行规范化

blocks.en: Streaming video often produces batches with high intra-batch similarity: consecutive frames can contain near-duplicate views of the same scene ( cf. Figure 3 ). In this regime, standard MAE may rely on short-term regularities, repeatedly reconstructing similar content with limited variation in appearance or structure. We therefore strengthen the MAE training pipeline with three lightweight mechanisms: color jitter, increased drop path rate, and DataDrop .
blocks.zh: 流线视频经常产生批次内置相似度高的批次:连续帧可以包含同一场景的近似重复的视图(参见图3). 在这个制度中,标准MAE可能依赖于短期的规律性,反复重建类似的内容,外观或结构的差别有限. 因此,我们用三种轻量级机制加强MAE训练管道:色调紧张、下降率提高和DataDrop。

blocks.en: Color jitter. Color jitter increases appearance diversity by perturbing low-level statistics such as color, brightness, and contrast. This makes reconstruction less dependent on stable appearance cues that persist across neighboring frames.
blocks.zh: 颜色焦躁. 色彩焦躁通过扰动颜色,亮度,对比度等低层次的统计来增加外观多样性. 这使得重建不再依赖于持续到周边框架的稳定的外观提示.

blocks.en: Drop path. Increasing the drop path rate [ 30 ] regularizes the encoder by varying the effective network depth across updates. This helps reduce overfitting to recurring local patterns in batches with high intra-batch similarity.
blocks.zh: 弃道. 提高下降路径速率[30]通过改变整个更新的有效网络深度来规范编码器. 这有助于减少在批次内类似度高的批次中因地制宜地重复出现的情况。

blocks.en: DataDrop . In streaming pretraining, each batch corresponds to a sliding window from the ordered stream ( Figure 2 ). When this window contains many highly similar frames, backpropagating through all examples can overemphasize near-duplicate content. We therefore use DataDrop : for each batch, we sample a binary mask over examples and compute the loss only on the retained subset. Dropped examples are not forwarded through the model and do not contribute to the current update. Training then proceeds to the next window according to the stream stride s s . By default, we drop 75 % 75\% of examples in each batch, reducing the effective batch size for backpropagation by a factor of four.
blocks.zh: 数据Drop. 在溪流预训中,每批对应于来自命令溪流的滑动窗口(图2 ). 当这个窗口包含许多高度相似的帧时,通过所有实例的反向传播可以过分强调近似重复的内容. 因此,我们使用DataDrop : 对于每批,我们用实例来取样一个二进制掩码,并且只计算保留子集的损失. 已丢弃的示例不通过模型传输,也无助于当前更新. 然后,培训按照溪流步态S 进入下一个窗口。 默认情况下,我们在每个批次中会减少75%的75×××例,将反播的有效批次尺寸减少4倍.

blocks.en: 4.3 Stream-Aware Cropping
blocks.zh: 4.3 流动人工裁剪

blocks.en: Two-stage cropping. MAE applies random resized cropping directly to the input frame. In streaming video, however, adjacent frames are often globally similar, so independently sampled crops from neighboring frames can still show near-duplicate content. We therefore use a two-stage cropping procedure that exposes the crop location as a separate design choice. First, we sample a fixed-size crop from the frame, defining a local spatial region. We then apply the standard MAE random resized crop within this region. This preserves the original MAE augmentation pipeline while making the sampled view depend on an explicit first-stage region selection.
blocks.zh: 两阶段收割. MAE将随机调整的裁剪直接应用于输入框. 然而,在流媒体视频中,相邻的帧往往具有全球相似性,因此从相邻的帧中独立采样的农作物仍然可以显示近似重复的内容. 因此,我们采用两阶段的种植程序,将作物位置暴露为单独的设计选择。 首先,我们从框架中取样一个固定大小的作物,确定一个局部空间区域。 然后,我们在该地区采用标准MAE随机调整的作物规模。 这保留了原有的MAE增强管,同时使采样视图依赖于明确的第一阶段区域选择.

blocks.en: This formulation separates where to crop from how to augment the final training view. A simple version samples the first-stage region uniformly at random. We next make this selection stream-aware by biasing it toward regions with recent visual change.

blocks.en: Training details. We use ViT-Small (ViT-S/16) [ 16 ] as our main architecture and report ViT-B/16 results for StreamMAE when scaling encoder size. All SSL methods are implemented in solo-learn [ 13 ] and trained from scratch. We use AdamW [ 32 ] with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , and base learning rates 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} for ViT-S and 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} for ViT-B. The learning rate is scaled linearly with the effective batch size, B eff / 256 B_{\mathrm{eff}}/256 . Streaming runs use a constant learning rate with linear warm-up, consistent with the goal of continuing pretraining as new videos arrive.
blocks.zh: 培训详情。 我们使用ViT-Small(ViT-S/16)[16]作为我们的主要架构,并在缩放编码器大小时报告StreamMAE的ViT-B/16结果. 所有SSL方法都是在独家学习[13]中实施,并从零开始训练. 我们使用 AdamW [32],其中 β 1 = 0.9\β1 = 0.9\0.9,β 2 = 0.95\β2\ = 0.95, 基础学习率 8 × 10 = 5 8\ 10\ = 5 = 10\ = 5\ = VIT-S,4 × 10\ = 5 = 4\ = 10\ = = 5\ = = VIT-B. 学习速率随有效批量大小Beff / 256 B_{\mathrm{eff}}/256 线性缩放. 流线运行采用线性暖化的恒定学习率,与新视频到来后继续预训的目标一致.

blocks.en: Our default pretraining stream is WT++12h , a 12-hour London walking-tour video from WT++ . For larger-scale pretraining, we sequentially append videos to form WT++25h , WT++50h , and WT++95h , corresponding to approximately 25, 50, and 95 hours of data. Each stream extends the preceding one by appending new videos while retaining all earlier videos in the same order ( cf .  Appendix C ). The original videos are recorded at 60 FPS and processed at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . We temporally subsample them by a factor of k = 16 k=16 , yielding 3.75 FPS. Streaming batches use stride s = 1 s=1 , except for WT++95h experiments where we use s = 2 s=2 to reduce training time. We form local stream windows of size B = 2048 B=2048 and apply DataDrop with drop probability 0.75 0.75 , yielding effective batch size B eff = 512 B_{\mathrm{eff}}=512 .
blocks.zh: 我们的默认预训流是WT++12h,是WT++的12小时伦敦步行的视频. 对于规模更大的预训,我们依次附加视频,形成WT++25h,WT++50h,以及WT++95h,相当于大约25,50和95小时的数据. 每条流通过附加新的视频来延长前一条流,同时保留所有先前的视频的顺序相同(参见附录C). 原始视频收录于60 FPS,处理时间为1280×720 1280\times 720. 在时间上,我们用K=16k=16的系数对它们进行子样本,生成3.75 FPS. 流体批量使用strip s=1 s=1,但WT++95h实验除外,我们使用s=2 s=2来缩短训练时间. 我们形成大小 B = 2048 B = 2048 的本地流窗口,并应用 DataDrop 的下降概率为 0.75 0.75 ,产生有效批量大小 B eff = 512 B → mathrm{eff → 512 。

blocks.en:
For MAE-based methods, we use the standard masking ratio 0.75 0.75 with random uniform masking [ 26 ] . We compare this choice with two alternatives in Appendix A.6 . The default StreamMAE uses color jitter ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ), a linear drop-path schedule reaching 0.25 0.25 in the final block,
DataDrop, two-stage cropping, and motion-biased crop selection with K = 4 K=4 candidate crops. Further implementation details, including crop selection and compute requirements, are provided in Appendix E and G .
blocks.zh:
对于基于MAE的方法,我们使用标准遮罩比0.75 0.75,随机统一遮罩[26]. 我们将此选择与附录A.6中的两个备选案文进行比较。 默认的StreamMAE使用color jitter(p = 0.5 p = 0.5),在最后块中线性滴出路径表达到0.250.25,
DataDrop,两阶段作物,运动偏差作物选育方式为K=4K=4候选作物. 进一步的实施细节,包括作物选择和计算要求,载于附录E和G。

blocks.en: Evaluation. Following established MAE evaluation protocols [ 26 ] and recent recommendations for semantic segmentation [ 31 ] , we use end-to-end fine-tuning as our primary evaluation protocol. We additionally report attentive probing for classification in Table 10 to evaluate the frozen representations. For classification, we use ImageNet-1K [ 15 ] . For dense prediction, we use close-to-domain outdoor benchmarks, Cityscapes [ 12 ] and KITTI [ 19 ] , and out-of-domain benchmarks, ADE20K [ 57 ] and NYU-Depth-v2 [ 46 ] . We initialize the encoder from the pretrained checkpoint and fine-tune it with a task-specific head: a linear head for segmentation and DPT [ 41 ] for depth estimation. We report top-1 val accuracy for classification, mIoU for segmentation, and RMSE for depth estimation. For depth estimation, we report mean ± std {\text{mean}}_{\pm\text{std}} over two seeds. More details are provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 评价。 根据既定的MAE评价协议[26]和最近的语义分解建议[31],我们使用端到端微调作为我们的首要评价协议. 我们还报告,在表10中认真调查了对冻结表述的评价。 对于分类,我们使用ImageNet-1K [15]. 对于密集的预测,我们使用近域室外基准,城市景观[12]和KITTI[19],以及域外基准,ADE20K[57]和NYU-Depth-v2[46]. 我们从预先训练的检查站初始化编码器,并用任务特定头进行微调:一个线性头用于分区,而DPT[41]用于深度估计. 我们报告分类的顶级-1Val精度,分类的mIoU精度,深度估计的RMSE精度。 对于深度估计,我们报告的意思是 ± std \ text{mean\pm\ text{std} 超过两个种子。 详情见附录F。

blocks.en: 5.1 Benchmarking Self-Supervised Methods under Streaming Pretraining
blocks.zh: 5.1 自行监督基准 预先培训方法

blocks.en: Table 3: Benchmarking SSL methods under streaming pretraining (ViT-S). We compare WT++12h streaming methods to random initialization, i.i.d. MAE on WT++12h , and an iteration-matched ImageNet-1K i.i.d. MAE reference. † marks reproduced streaming-tailored methods.
blocks.zh: 表3:在流化预训(ViT-S)下设定SSL方法的基准. 我们比较WT++12h流化方法与随机初始化,即WT++12h上的MAE,以及一个迭代匹配的ImageNet-1K即MAE参考. · 印记复制了流线方法。

blocks.en:
We first benchmark representative SSL methods under our streaming protocol and evaluate representations with full fine-tuning on downstream tasks. Details of baseline tuning and adaptations to temporal redundancy are provided in Appendices D and E.4 .
As shown in Table 3 , MAE is a stronger streaming baseline than MoCo v3 [ 10 ] and DINO [ 5 ] . MoCo v3 even falls below random initialization on ImageNet-1K, consistent with contrastive learning being sensitive to high intra-batch similarity where near-duplicate frames can act as false negatives. DINO is more stable, but still trails MAE on most downstream tasks. Streaming-tailored baselines do not close the gap. MAE with Orthogonal-AdamW [ 22 ] underperforms standard streaming MAE, and our reproduction of MemoryStoryboard [ 56 ] with ViT-S remains below MAE despite using a replay buffer ( cf. Appendix D ). In contrast, StreamMAE improves over all streaming baselines and is comparable to standard IID MAE trained on the same WT++12h data. Scaling StreamMAE to WT++95h further improves transfer, especially on dense prediction. We also include an ImageNet-1K IID MAE reference trained for the same number of iterations as the WT++12h streaming runs.
blocks.zh:
我们首先根据流线协议采用具有代表性的SSL方法,并用对下游任务的全面微调来评价表述。 基准调整和适应时间冗余的细节载于附录D和E.4。
如表3所示,MAE是比MOCo v3 [10] 和DINO [5]更强的流线基线. MoCo v3甚至低于ImageNet-1K上的随机初始化,这与对比性学习对高秒内相似性敏感一致,因为近复制帧可以起到假底片的作用. DINO较为稳定,但仍在大部分下游任务上跟随MAE. 串流的精确基线无法弥合差距。 带有Orthogonal-AdamW [22] 的MAE在标准流化的MAE上表现不佳,尽管使用了重播缓冲器(参见附录D),但我们使用ViT-S的记忆故事板的复制仍然低于MAE. 相比之下,StreamMAE在所有流线基线上都有改进,并且与基于WT++12h数据培训的标准IIDMAE相当. 将StreamMAE扩展至WT++95h,进一步改善了转移,特别是在密集预测方面。 我们还包括一个ImageNet-1K IID MAE的参考文献,为WT++12h流线运行所培训的相同次数的迭代.

blocks.en: Ablation study. We perform cumulative ablations using a ViT-S/16 backbone pretrained on WT++12h . As shown in Figure 6 , the proposed design choices progressively improve dense transfer. DataDrop yields modest gains, while stronger regularization and crop selection account for most of the improvement. Motion-biased crop selection gives the largest gains on close-to-domain outdoor benchmarks, Cityscapes [ 12 ] and KITTI [ 19 ] . Later experiments show that DataDrop becomes negligible at larger scale, whereas regularization and crop selection remain the main components. The MAE baseline in this ablation uses B = 512 B=512 , which gives stronger performance in our setup ( cf. Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 校勘研究. 我们使用在WT++12h上经过预先训练的VIT-S/16骨干进行累积烧伤。 如图6所示,拟议的设计选择逐步改善密集转移。 数据 降水收益不大,而加强正规化和作物选择则占了大部分改进。 运动有偏见的作物选择在近域户外基准、城市景观[12]和KITTI[19]上获得了最大的收益。 后来的实验表明,DataDrop在更大范围内变得微不足道,而规范化和作物选择仍然是主要的组成部分. 本次衰减中的MAE基线使用B = 512 B = 512,这使我们的设置具有更强的性能(参见附录A.4).

blocks.en: Figure 6: Cumulative ablation study with ViT-S/16 pretrained on WT++12h . Each row adds one component to the previous setting. DataDrop gives modest gains, while stronger regularization and crop selection account for most of the dense-transfer improvement. CS denotes crop selection.
blocks.zh: 图6:VIT-S/16在WT++12h上预训的累积延展研究。 每行在上一个设置中添加一个组件. 数据 下降略有改善,而更严格的正规化和作物选择则占了转移密集性改进的大部分。 CS表示作物选择.

blocks.en: 5.2 Scaling and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 放大和分析

blocks.en: We next analyze the scaling behavior of StreamMAE by varying encoder capacity and pretraining duration, and examine whether its design choices remain beneficial at larger scale.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来分析StreamMAE通过不同编码器容量和预训期的缩放行为,并检查其设计选择是否在更大范围内仍然有益.

blocks.en: Scaling encoder capacity. We scale the encoder to ViT-B/16 while keeping the pretraining stream fixed to WT++12h . As shown in Table 4 , increasing model capacity alone does not close the gap between streaming baseline and standard i.i.d. MAE, particularly on dense prediction. Orthogonal-MAE provides modest gains over streaming MAE, but remains below StreamMAE. In contrast, StreamMAE scales effectively: it nearly matches standard i.i.d. MAE on ImageNet-1K and ADE20K, surpasses it on Cityscapes, and substantially improves depth estimation over streaming MAE. The ImageNet-1K i.i.d. MAE reference is trained for the same number of iterations as the WT++12h runs.
blocks.zh: 扩大编码能力。 我们把编码器缩放到VIT-B/16,同时将预训流固定在WT++12h. 如表4所示,单靠提高模型能力并不能弥合流线基线和标准(即d)之间的差距。 特别在密集预测上 整形-MAE比流式的MAE提供微小的收益,但仍低于流式MAE. 相比之下,StreamMAE尺度是有效的:它几乎与ImageNet-1K和ADE20K上的标准即MAE相匹配,超过了Cityscapes上的标准,并且大大改进了对流中的MAE的深度估计. (原始内容存档于2018-09-09). The ImageNet-1K i.id. MAE参考培训的重复次数与WT++12h运行次数相同。

blocks.en: Table 4: Increasing encoder size . StreamMAE (ViT-B) improves over both StreamMAE (ViT-S) and the MAE baseline, while closing most of the gap to standard i.i.d. MAE. † marks our reproduction.
blocks.zh: 表4:增加编码器的尺寸 . StreamMAE(ViT-B)比SreamMAE(ViT-S)和MAE基线都有所改善,同时将大部分差距缩小到标准即d. 大师。 我们的复制。

blocks.en: Scaling pretraining duration. We next scale the pretraining stream by sequentially appending additional walking-tour videos to WT++12h . As shown in Table 6 , performance generally improves with longer streams for both ViT-S/16 and ViT-B/16. We additionally compare the WT++95h runs against standard i.i.d. MAE pretrained on ImageNet-1K under the same longer budget of 650 ​ k 650\mathrm{k} iterations, as reported in Appendix Table 21 . With ViT-S/16, StreamMAE matches this longer reference on IN-1K and exceeds it on both segmentation benchmarks. With ViT-B/16, it remains competitive on IN-1K and Cityscapes but trails on ADE20K. Overall, these results show that StreamMAE benefits from additional streaming data while remaining close to the longer-budget, iteration-matched i.i.d. MAE reference on most benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 延长预训时间。 我们接下来通过依次将额外的步行图视频附加到WT++12h来放大预训流. 如表6所示,ViT-S/16和ViT-B/16的性能一般会随着流长而改善。 我们还比较了WT++95h的运行情况,与附录表21中报告的在650k650\mathrm{k}重排量相同的长期预算下在ImageNet-1K上预先培训的MAE标准相比。 使用Vit-S/16,StreamMAE在IN-1K上与这个较长的参考量相匹配,并在两个分区基准上都超过了它. 在VIT-B/16中,它在IN-1K和Cityscapes上仍然具有竞争力,但在ADE20K上则有足迹. 总的来说,这些结果表明,StreamMAE受益于额外的流数据,同时仍然接近较长的预算,迭代匹配即d. 多数基准都提到MAE。

blocks.en: We further analyze the role of DataDrop under this scaling regime in Table 6 . While DataDrop provides modest gains in the default ViT-S/16 setting, its effect becomes negligible for ViT-B/16 when scaling pretraining to WT++50h or WT++95h . This suggests that DataDrop is useful at smaller scale (see also Figure 6 ), but is not the main driver of performance once model capacity and stream duration are increased. Here, the no- DataDrop setting uses B = 512 B=512 , corresponding to roughly 136 seconds of video at 3.75 FPS. Additional batch-size sensitivity results are provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 在表6中,我们进一步分析了DataDrop在这一规模制度下的作用。 虽然DataDrop在默认的VIT-S/16设置中提供了微小的增益,但当将预训缩放到WT++50h或WT++95h时,其对VIT-B/16的效果变得微不足道. 这表明DataDrop在较小的尺度上有用(另见图6),但一旦模型容量和流量持续时间增加,它就不是业绩的主要驱动力. 这里,无数据Drop设定使用B=512 B=512,相当于3.75 FPS的大约136秒视频. 附录A.3提供了额外的批量敏感度结果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Scaling pretraining video stream duration.
blocks.zh: 表5 扩大预训视频流持续时间。

blocks.en: Table 6: Effect of DataDrop at scale. Its contribution is negligible for ViT-B on longer pretraining videos.
blocks.zh: 表6:大规模数据滴效应。 在较长的预训视频方面,Vit-B的贡献微不足道。

blocks.en: Table 7: Checkpoint averaging on the same ViT-B WT++95h trajectory improves dense transfer with negligible change in IN-1K accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表7:同一VIT-B WT++95h轨迹上的平均检查点改善密度转移,IN-1K精度变化微乎其微。

blocks.en: Checkpoint averaging for long streaming runs. Inspired by continual learning setups [ 35 , 43 ] , we additionally examine whether averaging checkpoints from a long streaming run can improve the final representation. For ViT-B/16 pretrained on WT++95h , we average weights from checkpoints saved at different stages of the same training trajectory. Percentages denote the fraction of training completed at each checkpoint. As shown in Table 7 , this simple procedure improves dense prediction performance while leaving IN-1K accuracy essentially unchanged. These results suggest that checkpoints from different stages of pretraining may retain complementary information.
blocks.zh: 长流运行的检查点平均值 。 在不断学习[35、43]的启发下,我们进一步审查长期检查站的平均数是否能改善最终代表性。 对于在WT++95h上预先训练的Vit-B/16,我们平均从同一训练轨迹的不同阶段节省的检查站重量。 百分比表示在每个检查站完成培训的比例。 如表7所示,这一简单程序提高了密度预测性能,同时使IN-1K精度基本保持不变。 这些结果表明,不同培训阶段的检查站可能保留补充信息。

blocks.en: More updates versus new visual content. We next ask whether scaling gains come from more optimization steps or from new visual content. Table 9 shows that increasing the effective number of updates by using higher FPS does not improve transfer and can hurt dense prediction.
blocks.zh: 更多更新与新视觉内容. 我们接下来问,扩大规模是来自更多优化步骤,还是来自新的视觉内容。 表9显示,通过使用更高的FPS来增加有效更新数量并不能改善传输,而且会伤害密集的预测.

blocks.en: Table 8: Effect of temporal subsampling on WT++12h with ViT-B. Denser sampling increases the effective number of updates, but does not improve performance.
blocks.zh: 表8:时间亚采样对WT++12h与ViT-B. Denser采样的效果增加了有效的更新数量,但并没有提高性能.

blocks.en: Table 9: Effect of repeating the data. Additional passes over WT++12h improve performance, but new videos yield larger gains.
blocks.zh: 表9:重复数据的效果。 超过WT++12h的额外传球提高了性能,但新视频产生更大的收益.

blocks.en: Table 9 shows that StreamMAE can still benefit from additional epochs over the same stream, indicating that it does not require extreme data diversity to improve. However, streams that include new videos perform better than repeated epochs over WT++12h , suggesting that newly introduced scenes provide additional gains. These results suggest that longer-stream improvements are not explained by more updates alone. StreamMAE benefits from both continued optimization and increased visual diversity.
blocks.zh: 表9显示,流体 千年生态系统评估仍可从同一流的额外纪元中受益,表明它不需要极端的数据多样性来改进。 然而,包含新视频的流比WT++12h的反复历程表现更好,说明新引入的场景提供了额外的收益. 这些结果表明,仅靠更多的更新并不能解释长期改进的原因。 StreamMAE从持续优化和增加视觉多样性中获益。

blocks.en: Table 10: ImageNet-1K attentive probing evaluation after pretraining on WT++12h .
blocks.zh: 表10:在WT++12h进行预训后,ImageNet-1K专注测试评价.

blocks.en: We evaluate frozen representations on IN-1K by training only a single-query cross-attention pooling layer followed by a linear classifier. We follow the probing hyperparameters of Psomas et al. [39] and the augmentations of AIMv2 [ 18 ] . As shown in Table 10 , StreamMAE improves over streaming MAE by 6.8 6.8 and 9.8 9.8 Acc@1 points for ViT-S/16 and ViT-B/16, respectively, while matching same-data i.i.d. MAE.
blocks.zh: 我们评价IN-1K上被冻结的表述方式是,只培训一个单射线交叉集合层,然后是线性分类器。 我们跟踪Psomas等人的探测超参数[39]和AIMv2的增强[18]。 如表10所示,StreamMAE比流中的MAE分别提高了6.8和9.8的Acc@1分,为Vit-S/16和Vit-B/16,同时匹配了相同数据即d. 大师。

blocks.en: 5.3 Generalization Across Pretraining Domains
blocks.zh: 5.3 跨越预先培训领域的一般化

blocks.en: To examine whether StreamMAE extends beyond walking-tour video, we additionally pretrain ViT-B/16 on three diverse streams: HD-EPIC [ 38 ] , an indoor egocentric kitchen stream, CROWD [ 3 ] , a front-facing urban dashcam stream, and KrishnaCAM [ 47 ] , a longitudinal egocentric daily-life stream. For each pretraining dataset, we compare streaming MAE, StreamMAE, and standard i.i.d. MAE using the same frames and number of pretraining iterations.
blocks.zh: 为了研究StreamMAE是否超越步行-我们的视频,我们额外在三个不同的溪流上预训VIT-B/16:HD-EPIC[38],一个以室内自负为中心的厨房溪流,CROWD[3],一个前卫城市破碎凸轮流,以及KrishnaCAM[47],一个纵向自负中心的日常生活溪流. 对于每一个预训数据集,我们比较流式MAE,StreamMAE,和标准即d. MAE使用相同的帧和预训练迭代次数.

blocks.en: Table 11: Generalization across pretraining domains using ViT-B/16 .
blocks.zh: 表11:使用ViT-B/16对培训前领域进行普及。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 11 , StreamMAE consistently improves over streaming MAE across all four downstream tasks and all three domains, with gains of 1.6 1.6 – 5.8 5.8 mIoU on segmentation and reductions of 0.042 0.042 – 0.531 0.531 RMSE on depth estimation. On HD-EPIC and CROWD, StreamMAE matches or exceeds same-data i.i.d. MAE on every downstream task. On KrishnaCAM, it trails i.i.d. MAE by 0.1 0.1 mIoU on ADE20K and 0.005 0.005 RMSE on NYUv2, while outperforming it on Cityscapes and KITTI. Details of preprocessing and stream construction for all three datasets are provided in Appendix E.5 .
blocks.zh: 如表11所示,StreamMAE对所有四个下游任务和所有三个领域的流式MAE不断改进,在深度估计方面,分化和减少的RMSE为0.042 0.042 -0531。 在HD-EPIC和CROWD上,StreamMAE匹配或超过同一数据即d. 每一次下游任务都会有 在KrishnaCAM上,它在ADE20K上以0.1 mIoU比0.1 mIoU,在NYUv2上以0.005 0.005 RMSE比在Cityscapes和KITTI上表现优异。 所有三个数据集的预处理和流构细节见附录E.5。

blocks.en: We further ablate motion-biased crop selection on KrishnaCAM [ 47 ] , whose head-mounted viewpoint exhibits irregular camera motion across indoor and outdoor scenes. Relative to StreamMAE without motion-biased crop selection, the full method improves ADE20K and Cityscapes by 0.6 0.6 and 0.7 0.7 mIoU, respectively, and reduces KITTI RMSE by 0.063 0.063 , while leaving NYUv2 unchanged (full results are provided in Appendix Table 20 ). Motion-biased crop selection therefore remains beneficial beyond the walking-tour domain.
blocks.zh: 在克里希纳CAM上, 我们进一步淡化有运动偏见的作物选择, 相对于StreamMAE没有运动偏差的作物选择,全方法将ADE20K和Cityscape分别改进0.6和0.7 mIoU,将KITTI RMSE减少0.063 0.063,而NYUv2则保持不变(全部结果载于附录表20)。 因此,选择有偏见的作物仍然有益,超出了行走范围。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We studied self-supervised learning from continuous video, where models are trained from scratch on temporally ordered frames without global reshuffling or long-term replay buffers. We showed that contrastive [ 10 ] and self-distillation [ 5 ] methods struggle in this setting, while masked reconstruction provides a more robust starting point. Our analysis suggests that the main challenge for MAE is not inter-batch similarity from fixed-order sliding-window consumption, but high intra-batch similarity caused by near-duplicate frames. Based on this insight, we introduced StreamMAE, which keeps the MAE objective while adapting the training pipeline to
mitigate the effects of high intra-batch similarity
and focus learning on more informative regions of the stream. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, is competitive with standard i.i.d. MAE, and scales to longer video streams.
blocks.zh:
我们从连续的视频中学习了自我监督的学习,从头到尾的模型在按时订购的帧上得到训练,而没有全球的重排或长期重播缓冲. 我们显示,对比性[10]和自我消化[5]方法在此环境中挣扎,而蒙面重建则提供了一个更强有力的起点。 我们的分析表明,MAE的主要挑战不是固定顺序滑窗消费产生的批次间相似性,而是近似重复帧造成的批次内高度相似性. 基于这一见解,我们引入了StreamMAE, 它保持了MAE的目标,同时使培训管道适应
减轻批内高度相似性的影响
并将学习重点放在信息更丰富的溪流地区。 StreamMAE的表现超过了流线基线,具有与标准即MAE的竞争力,规模可达更长的视频流.

blocks.en: Appendix B Limitations and Open Challenges
blocks.zh: 附录B 限制和公开挑战

blocks.en: We acknowledge several limitations of our study. First, except for motion-biased crop selection, StreamMAE does not explicitly model temporal dynamics. Extending StreamMAE to architectures or objectives that directly exploit temporal information remains an important direction for future work. Second, StreamMAE relies on fixed frame subsampling to reduce the effective frame rate, motivated by the observation in Table 9 that denser temporal sampling can degrade performance. However, fixed subsampling is likely suboptimal, since the rate of visual change can vary substantially throughout a video, as illustrated in Figure 3 . Adaptive temporal sampling may therefore better match the local dynamics of the stream. Finally, we only consider checkpoint averaging at evaluation time, while incorporating long-timescale consolidation directly into streaming pretraining remains unexplored.
blocks.zh: 我们承认我们的研究有一些局限性。 首先,除了运动偏差的作物选择,StreamMAE没有明确模拟时间动态. 将StreamMAE扩展至直接利用时间信息的结构或目标仍然是未来工作的一个重要方向。 第二,StreamMAE依靠固定的帧子采样来降低有效帧速率,其动机是表9中观察到更密集的时间采样可以降解性能. 然而,如图3所示,固定的子取样可能不够理想,因为整个视频的视觉变化率可能大不相同。 因此,适应性时间取样可能更符合溪流的当地动态。 最后,我们仅考虑在评价时平均检查点,而将长期规模的合并直接纳入流动的预先训练,仍未加以探讨。

blocks.en: For the MemoryStoryboard baseline, we use the official codebase and replace the default ResNet-50 [ 28 ] encoder with ViT-S/16 to match the architecture used in our main comparisons. The encoder is initialized from scratch, and we use the final [CLS] token as the image representation. We train on the WT++London stream with 224 × 224 224\times 224 crops, a short FIFO memory of 2048 2048 samples, and a long reservoir memory of 16384 16384 samples. Each batch contains 64 current-stream samples and 448 replay samples, giving an effective batch size of 512. We additionally swept the stream stride and reservoir size and evaluated input resolutions of 112 × 112 112\times 112 , as used in the original setup, and 224 × 224 224\times 224 . The reported configuration uses stride s = 2 s=2 , which performed better than s = 1 s=1 .

blocks.en:
As MemoryStoryboard uses SimSiam [ 9 ] and SimCLR [ 7 ] objectives, we evaluate both, and tune the learning rate over { 8 × 10 − 5 , 10 − 4 , 3 × 10 − 4 } \{8\times 10^{-5},10^{-4},3\times 10^{-4}\} . The best result is obtained with SimCLR and learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , which is the configuration reported in Figure 1 and Table 3 . We use AdamW with weight decay 0.05 0.05 and enable the default label-merging procedure.
We also evaluated the original ResNet-50 recipe on WT++12h using only the most recent 2048 2048 frames, without long-term replay. Under this constrained memory setting, the learned representations showed signs of collapse, so we do not report downstream results for this configuration.

由于记忆故事板使用SimSiam [9] 和SimCLR [7] 目标,我们评价这两个目标,并将学习率调到 {8 × 10 − 5, 10 − 4 , 3 × 10 − 4 } {8 \ 时间 10^{5},10^{4},3\4}\}. 最佳结果与SimCLR和学习率10−4 10^{-4},这是图1和表3中报告的配置. 我们使用 亚当W 的重量衰减 0.05 0.05 并启用默认的标签合并程序。

blocks.en: Since MemoryStoryboard was originally developed with ResNet-50 backbones and SimSiam/SimCLR objectives, adapting it to ViT-S/16 may require additional architecture-specific tuning. We therefore view this result as a controlled reproduction under our ViT-S/16 streaming evaluation protocol rather than as an exhaustive optimization of the method. In particular, the original MemoryStoryboard setup uses larger strides between consecutive batches, which may be an additional direction for optimizing its performance in our setting.
blocks.zh: 由于记忆故事板最初是用ResNet-50主干线和SimSiam/SimCLR目标开发的,因此根据ViT-S/16进行改造可能需要额外的建筑特异性调理. 因此,我们将这一结果视为根据我们的ViT-S/16流式评价协议进行有控制的复制,而不是对该方法的彻底优化。 特别是,最初的记忆故事板设置在连续批次之间采用了更大的跨度,这可能是在我们的设定中优化其性能的又一个方向.

blocks.en: E.2 Two-Stage Cropping and Motion-Biased Crop Selection
blocks.zh: E.2 双层作物和机动双层作物选择

blocks.en: Videos are originally resized to 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 resolution. For two-stage cropping, the first-stage crop size is 592 × 336 592\times 336 , approximately preserving the 16:9 aspect ratio while remaining aligned with the ViT patch grid. The final MAE random resized crop is then applied within this first-stage region. For motion-biased crop selection, we cache frame-difference scores at the ViT patch level. Since the ViT patch size is 16 16 , each 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 frame yields a compact 80 × 45 80\times 45 patch-level difference map. This cache is inexpensive to store and avoids recomputing frame differences or reloading frames when selecting motion-biased crops. First-stage crop candidates are constrained to be aligned with the ViT patch grid, so their motion scores can be computed directly from the cached patch-level differences. When DataDrop is used, patch-level differences are still computed for the local stream window before example dropping. Thus, crop selection can use the same cached difference maps, while only the retained examples contribute to the training loss.
blocks.zh: 视频最初被调整为1280×720 1280\times 720分辨率. 对于两级作物,第一阶段作物尺寸为592×336 592\times 336,大致保持16:9的宽度比,同时保持与VIT补丁网格一致. 最终的MAE随机调整大小的作物随后应用在这个第一阶段的区域. 对于运动偏差的裁剪选择,我们缓存 VIT 补丁级别的帧偏差分数. 由于ViT补丁尺寸为16 16,因此每个1280×720 1280\times 720帧产生一个紧凑的80×45 80\times 45补丁级差异图. 这种缓存在选择带有运动偏差的作物时,对于存储和避免重算帧差异或重装帧来说是便宜的. 第一阶段的作物选手被限制与ViT补丁网格对齐,因此他们的运动分数可以直接从缓存的补丁级别差异中计算. 当使用 DataDrop 时, 仍然会计算本地流窗口的补丁级别差异, 然后再进行示例的下架 。 因此,作物选择可以使用相同的缓存差异图,而只有保留的例子会助长训练损失.

blocks.en: E.3 Training i.i.d. Baselines
blocks.zh: E.3 培训即基线

blocks.en: The i.i.d. MAE baselines on ImageNet-1K and WT++London , reported in Tables 2 , 3 and 4 , are trained with an iteration-matched protocol. That is, each i.i.d. baseline is trained for the same number of optimization steps as the corresponding streaming run on WT++London . These baselines are therefore not intended to reproduce fully optimized MAE pretraining schedules. They provide controlled references at the same training budget as our streaming experiments.
blocks.zh: 表2、表3和表4所报告的ImageNet-1K和WT++-London的磁共振基线都经过了重迭匹配协议的培训。 也就是说,每个i.d. 基线都经过培训,与WT++上相应的流线运行相同。 伦敦. 因此,这些基线的目的不是要复制完全优化的MAE预训时间表。 它们提供了与我们流线实验相同的培训预算的受控参考。

blocks.en: By i.i.d. training, we mean that each optimization step samples a batch uniformly at random from the full dataset, without preserving temporal order or using sliding-window batches. We train these i.i.d. baselines with the standard MAE cosine learning-rate schedule, whereas streaming runs use a constant learning rate with linear warm-up of 5% of total number of iterations. Unless stated otherwise, the batch size is 512 512 . For IN-1K ViT-B/16 i.i.d. experiments, we use base learning rate 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} with linear batch-size scaling. For ViT-S/16, we use base learning rate 3.2 × 10 − 4 3.2\times 10^{-4} , which performed better.

blocks.en: The fixed-order pre-shuffled ImageNet-1K experiment in Table 2 is also iteration-matched. We pre-shuffle ImageNet-1K once, consume the resulting sequence as a fixed stream with batch size B = 512 B=512 and stride s = 8 s=8 , and train for approximately the same number of steps as the corresponding i.i.d. baseline.

blocks.en: E.4 SSL Baselines
blocks.zh: E.4 SSL基线

blocks.en: We reproduce three representative SSL baselines in our streaming video setup: DINO [ 5 ] , MAE [ 26 ] , and MoCo v3 [ 10 ] . All methods are implemented in solo-learn [ 13 ] and trained from scratch on the WT++12h stream using the same single-traversal sliding window protocol. Unless stated otherwise, batches are formed in temporal order with stride s = 1 s=1 , and baselines use a local stream window of size B = 2048 B=2048 with DataDrop , yielding an effective batch size of 512. Training uses mixed precision, synchronized batch normalization when required by the method, and a constant learning rate with linear warm-up.
blocks.zh: 我们转载了三个具有代表性的SSL基线在流视频设置:DINO [5],MAE [26],MoCo v3 [10]. 所有方法均在独行学习[13]中实施,并在WT++12h流上采用相同的单向滑动窗口协议从头开始训练. 除另有说明外,批量按时间顺序形成,标尺S=1 s=1,基线使用大小B=2048 B=2048的本地流窗口,与DataDrop 形成有效批量大小512. 训练采用混合精度,方法需要时同步批量正常化,并采用线性暖化的恒定学习率.

blocks.en: DINO [ 5 ] . We train DINO with a ViT-S/16 backbone, AdamW, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.04 0.04 , and teacher momentum increased from 0.996 0.996 to 0.9996 0.9996 with a cosine schedule. We use 8192 8192 prototypes, projection hidden dimension 2048 2048 , projection output dimension 256 256 , student temperature 0.1 0.1 , and teacher temperature 0.04 0.04 . The augmentation pipeline follows the multi-crop recipe with two global 224 × 224 224\times 224 crops and four local 96 × 96 96\times 96 crops. Increasing the number of prototypes or local crops did not lead to consistent improvements.
blocks.zh: 迪诺 [5]. 我们用ViT-S/16骨干培训DINO,AdamW,学习率10−4 10^{-4},体重衰减0.04 0.04,教师动力从0.996 0.996增加到0.996 0.9996,并带有余弦表. 我们使用8192 8192原型,投影隐藏尺寸2048 2048,投影输出尺寸256 256,学生温度0.1,教师温度0.04 0.04. 增殖管道采用多作物配方,配有两株全球224×224×224×时的农作物和四株当地96×9696×时的农作物. 增加原型作物或当地作物的数量并没有导致持续改善。

blocks.en: MAE [ 26 ] . We train MAE with a ViT-S/16 backbone, AdamW, learning rate 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.05 0.05 , and AdamW betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) . We use the standard masking ratio of 0.75 0.75 , normalized pixel loss, and a decoder with embedding dimension 512 512 , depth 8 8 , and 16 16 attention heads. The MAE baseline uses a single 224 × 224 224\times 224 reconstruction crop with random resized cropping and horizontal flipping, without color jitter or blur. We also evaluate MAE with Orthogonal-AdamW [ 22 ] using the same configuration.
blocks.zh: [26]。 我们用Vit-S/16骨干训练MAE, AdamW, 学习率8×10−5 8\times 10×5}, 重量衰减 0.05 0.05, 和 AdamW βs (0.9, 0.95). 我们使用0.75 0.75的标准掩码比,正常像素丢失,以及嵌入维度512 512的解码器,深度8 8,以及16个注意头. MAE基线使用单一的224×224/224\times 224重建作物,随机调整作物大小和水平翻转,不带色调或模糊. 我们还使用同样的配置,对MAE进行评估。

blocks.en: MoCo v3 [ 10 ] . We train MoCo v3 with a ViT-S/16 backbone, AdamW, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.1 0.1 , and teacher momentum increased from 0.996 0.996 to 0.9996 0.9996 with a cosine schedule. The projection and prediction hidden dimensions are 4096 4096 , the projection output dimension is 256 256 , and the contrastive temperature is 0.2 0.2 . We use the standard asymmetric two-crop MoCo v3 augmentation pipeline with two 224 × 224 224\times 224 crops, color jitter, grayscale augmentation, Gaussian blur, and solarization. Increasing the effective batch size (i.e., removing DataDrop ) did not improve MoCo v3 in our streaming setup (please see Table 15 ). For StreamMAE, we follow the standard MoCo v3 color-jitter setting: brightness 0.4 0.4 , contrast 0.4 0.4 , saturation 0.2 0.2 , and hue 0.1 0.1 , and apply it with probability 0.5 0.5 .
blocks.zh: MoCo v3 [10] (英语). 我们用VIT-S/16骨干训练MoCo v3,AdamW,学习率10−4 10^{-4},体重衰减0.1,师资动力从0.996 0.996增长到0.996 0.9996,有余弦排程. 投影和预测隐藏的维度为4096 4096,投影输出维度为256 256,对比温度为0.2 0.2. 我们使用标准的非对称双作物 MoCo v3 增强管道, 有两个224×224\时 224\时的农作物, 颜色焦躁, 灰度增强, 高斯模糊, 和太阳能化。 增加有效批量大小(即删除 DataDrop ) 并没有改进我们流式设置中的 MoCo v3(请见表15)。 为流 MAE,我们遵循标准 MoCo v3 色热设置:亮度 0.4 0.4,对比 0.4 0.4,饱和度 0.2 0.1,并用概率 0.5 0.5 应用.

blocks.en: Streaming-specific adaptations. We did not assume a priori that MAE would be the strongest objective. We swept the baselines over learning rate, batch size, teacher momentum, crop configuration, and prototype count where applicable. We also tested several adaptations designed specifically for high temporal redundancy.
blocks.zh: 流化专项改造. 我们没有预先假定MAE是最强的目标。 我们从学习率、批量规模、师资动力、作物布局以及适当时的原型计数等基线上, 我们还测试了专门为高时间冗余量设计的几套适应软件。

blocks.en: For MoCo v3 , we tested multiple temporal positives, temporally soft targets, slow and fast EMA teachers with different momentum values, and periodic checkpoint merging and reinitialization. None of these variants resolved the optimization instability or prevented downstream transfer from degrading as pretraining progressed.
blocks.zh: 在MoCo v3中, 我们测试了多个时间性阳性, 时间性柔软的目标, 这些变体没有一个能解决优化的不稳定性,或防止随着预训的进展而出现下游退化的转移。

blocks.en: For DINO , we tested slow and fast EMA teachers, slow- and fast-evolving prototypes, updates restricted to hard examples, and Sinkhorn-Knopp assignment after observing low prototype utilization. None of these variants consistently improved downstream transfer.
blocks.zh: 对DINO来说,我们测试了慢速的EMA教师,慢速的和快速的原型,更新仅限于硬例,以及Sinkhorn-Knopp在观察低原型利用率后的任务. 这些变体中没有一个在下游的转移得到持续改善。

blocks.en: We also tested Orthogonal-AdamW with MAE, MoCo v3, and DINO without consistent gains. DataDrop is applied to all streaming baselines in the main comparison because it matches or improves their corresponding no-drop configurations (see Table 15 ).
blocks.zh: 我们还用MAE、MoCo v3和DINO测试了Orthogonal-AdamW,但没有取得一致的收益。 DataDrop应用于主比较中的所有流线基线,因为它匹配或改进了相应的无滴配置(见表15 ).

blocks.en: E.5 Additional Pretraining Datasets
blocks.zh: E.5 额外预训数据集

blocks.en: We construct three additional ordered pretraining streams from HD-EPIC [ 38 ] , CROWD [ 3 ] , and KrishnaCAM [ 47 ] (see Tab. 11 ). For each dataset, we preserve the temporal order within individual videos and concatenate the selected videos into a single fixed stream.
blocks.zh: 我们从HD-EPIC[38]、CROWD[3]和KrishnaCAM[47]另外建造了三条订购的预训流(见TB.11)。 对于每个数据集,我们保留单个视频中的时间顺序,并将选定的视频压缩成一个单一的固定流.

blocks.en: HD-EPIC [ 38 ] contains egocentric video recorded entirely in kitchens. We use recordings from four kitchens, P01, P02, P06, and P08, preserving the provided chronological order. The constituent videos average approximately 15 minutes and form an 18-hour stream. We temporally sample the stream at 2.5 FPS, yielding approximately 160k pretraining iterations.
blocks.zh: HD-EPIC [38] 包含完全在厨房录制的以自我为中心的视频. 我们使用四个厨房的录音,即P01、P02、P06和P08,保留所提供的时间顺序。 组成视频平均约15分钟,形成18小时的流量。 我们用2.5 FPS时间对溪流进行采样,产生约160k的预训练迭代.

blocks.en: CROWD [ 3 ] contains front-facing urban dashcam video. We use 16 videos recorded in Edinburgh, Salt Lake City, Jinan, Da Nang, Quito, and Gold Coast. The videos average approximately 53.5 minutes and form a 14.5-hour stream. We temporally sample the stream at 4 FPS, yielding approximately 203k pretraining iterations.
blocks.zh: CROWD [3] 包含前置的城市破烂相机视频. 使用爱丁堡,盐湖城,济南,大南,基多,黄金海岸等16个录制的视频. 视频平均约53.5分钟,形成14.5小时流线. 我们暂时在4 FPS 上对溪流进行采样,产生约203k的预训练迭代.

blocks.en: KrishnaCAM [ 47 ] is a 70-hour longitudinal egocentric dataset covering indoor and outdoor daily life. Its constituent videos average approximately 9.5 minutes and are concatenated chronologically. We temporally sample the resulting stream at 1 FPS, yielding approximately 250k pretraining iterations. For KrishnaCAM, StreamMAE uses K = 2 K=2 candidate crops to reduce repeated selection of the same regions during stationary activities.
blocks.zh: KrishnaCAM[47]是一个70小时的纵向自我中心数据集,涵盖室内外的日常生活. 其组成视频平均约9.5分钟,按时间顺序排列。 我们以1 FPS 时间对产生的溪流进行采样,产生约250k的预训练迭代. 对KrishnaCAM而言,StreamMAE使用K=2K=2的候选作物,以减少在固定活动期间重复选择同一区域。

blocks.en: Appendix F Additional Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 其他评价细节

blocks.en: F.1 Image Classification
blocks.zh: F.1 图像分类

blocks.en: For ImageNet-1K [ 15 ] classification, we follow the MAE [ 26 ] fine-tuning protocol. We fine-tune ViT-S/16 and ViT-B/16 end-to-end at resolution 224 × 224 224\times 224 , initializing the backbone from the pretrained checkpoint and training a new linear classifier. For MAE-based models, we use global average pooling over patch tokens followed by normalization and a linear classifier; for DINO and MoCo v3, we use the final [CLS] token representation. We fine-tune for 100 epochs with AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, 5 warmup epochs, weight decay 0.05 0.05 , layer-wise learning-rate decay 0.65 0.65 , drop-path rate 0.1 0.1 , mixup 0.8 0.8 , cutmix 1.0 1.0 , and random erasing probability 0.25 0.25 . We use the learning-rate scaling rule lr = blr ⋅ B eff / 256 \mathrm{lr}=\mathrm{blr}\cdot B_{\mathrm{eff}}/256 , with blr = 5 × 10 − 4 \mathrm{blr}=5\times 10^{-4} and global batch size B eff = 1024 B_{\mathrm{eff}}=1024 . At evaluation time, images are resized to 256 pixels on the shorter side and center-cropped to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . We report top-1 accuracy on the ImageNet-1K validation set.
blocks.zh: 对于ImageNet-1K[15]分类,我们遵循MAE[26]微调协议. 我们根据第224x224/224\times 224号决议,对ViT-S/16和ViT-B/16端对端进行微调,从经过预先训练的检查站启动主干线,并培训一个新的线性分类器。 对于基于MAE的模型,我们使用全球平均集合在补丁符号之上,然后是正常化和一个线性分类器;对于DINO和MOCo v3,我们使用最后的[CLS]符号表示. 微调100个纪元与亚当W, 余弦学习率衰减, 5个暖化纪元, 重量衰减 0.05 0.05, 层层学习率衰减 0.65 0.65, 下降率 0.1, 混合 0. 8, cutmix 1.0 1.0, 随机消除概率 0.25 0.25。 我们使用学习率缩放规则 lr = blr = B eff / 256\ mathrm{ lr}=\ mathrm{ blr}\cdot B_{\ mathrm{eff}}/256,其中blr = 5×10 → 4\ mathrm{blr}=5\times 10^{-4}全球批量大小 B  eff = 1024 B_{\ mathrm{eff}}=1024 . 在评价时,图像的尺寸被调整为短侧256像素,中间凸起为224×224/224\times 224 . 我们在ImageNet-1K验证装置上报告最高1的准确度。

blocks.en: F.2 Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: F.2 语义分裂

blocks.en: For semantic segmentation, we follow the protocol of Kerssies et al. [31] . We evaluate ViT-S/16 and ViT-B/16 on ADE20K and Cityscapes by attaching a linear per-patch prediction head to the ViT encoder and fine-tuning the full model end-to-end. For pretrained checkpoints, only the encoder is initialized from the self-supervised weights; the segmentation head is initialized randomly.
blocks.zh: 对于语义分裂,我们遵循Kersies等人的协议. [31] (中文(简体) ). 我们在ADE20K和Cityscapes上评价VIT-S/16和VIT-B/16,方法是在VIT编码器上加上一个每帕的线性预测头,并对完整的模型端到端进行微调. 对于事先经过训练的检查站,只有编码器是从自我监督的重量中初始化的;分区头是随机初始化的.

blocks.en: We use AdamW [ 32 ] with polynomial learning-rate decay with power 0.9 0.9 . The segmentation head uses learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} . For pretrained models, the encoder learning rate is scaled by 0.5 0.5 , while randomly initialized models use the same learning rate for encoder and head. We train for 40k steps on ADE20K and 20k steps on Cityscapes with batch size 16 and mixed precision.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 AdamW [32] 与多诺米学率衰减 与功率 0.9 0.9. 分部头部使用学习率 10 - 4 10 - 4 4 。 对于预先训练的模型,编码器的学习速率缩放0.50.5,而随机初始化的模型对编码器和头部使用相同的学习速率. 我们在ADE20K上训练40k步,在城市景观上训练20k步,分批大小16个,混合精度.

blocks.en: Training augmentations include random horizontal flipping, color jitter, scale jitter in [ 0.5 , 2.0 ] [0.5,2.0] , padding when needed, and random cropping. Crop sizes are 512 × 512 512\times 512 for ADE20K and 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 for Cityscapes. Positional embeddings are interpolated to the target patch grid. At evaluation time, we use sliding-window inference with the same crop sizes and average logits in overlapping regions. We report validation mIoU.
blocks.zh: 训练增强包括随机水平翻转,色彩焦躁,规模焦躁在[0.5,2.0] [0.5,2.0]中,在需要时加压,以及随机裁剪. 农作物大小为512×512 512\时为ADE20K型,1024×1024 1024\时为城市风景区. 位置嵌入被插到目标补丁网格. 在评价时,我们使用滑窗推论,在重叠区域采用相同作物大小和平均对数。 我们报告验证mIoU。

blocks.en: F.3 Depth estimation
blocks.zh: F.3 深度估计

blocks.en:
For depth estimation, we follow the evaluation protocol used by Yang et al. [55] , but perform full-finetuning instead of evaluating frozen encoders.
Hence, we set the encoder learning rate to half that of the DPT [ 41 ] depth head.
The prediction head takes normalized patch tokens and CLS tokens from four intermediate encoder layers as input, concatenated along the channel dimension.
We set the minimum depth to 0.001 for both datasets and the maximum depth to 10 and 80 for NYUv2 and KITTI, respectively.
We train using the scale-invariant logarithmic loss (SiLog loss) for 60 epochs with a batch size of 32, a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for the depth head, and a weight decay of 0.01 0.01 .
We use linear warmup for the learning rate in the first 10 % 10\% of training.
During training, we use a crop size of 256 × 256 256\times 256 . During validation, we employ sliding-window inference with a stride of 2 3 \frac{2}{3} of the crop size, corresponding to 170 pixels, and average predictions in overlapping regions. For depth estimation, the reported metrics are mean ± \pm standard deviation over two fine-tuning runs with different seeds.
blocks.zh:
关于深度估计,我们遵循杨等人所用的评价规程. [55],但进行全finedation,而不是评价冷冻编码器.
因此,我们把编码器的学习率设定为DPT[41]深度头的一半.
预测头从四个中间编码器层中取出正常的补丁符号和CLS符号作为输入,沿通道维度调和.
我们把NYUv2和KITTI的数据集和最大深度分别定为0.001和80。
我们用规模变化不定的对数损失(SiLog lose)来训练60个纪元,批量大小为32个,深度头部的学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4,体重衰减为0.010.01。
我们使用线性热身 学习率在前10%的训练。
在训练期间,我们使用256×256256\时的作物大小。 在验证过程中,我们使用滑动窗口推论,其坡度为作物大小的2 3\frac{2}{3},相当于170像素,重叠区域的平均预测值。 就深度估计而言,所报告的衡量标准平均为±\\pm标准偏差,因为有两个不同种子的微调。

blocks.en: Appendix G Compute Resources
blocks.zh: 附录G 计算资源

blocks.en: We report approximate compute requirements in Table 24 . All runs were performed on NVIDIA H100 GPUs with mixed-precision training. Wall-clock times for pretraining exclude downstream fine-tuning. The full research project required additional compute for preliminary experiments, hyperparameter sweeps, and failed runs that are not included in the table.
blocks.zh: 我们报告在表24中大致计算所需经费。 所有运行均在NVIDIA H100 GPU上进行,进行混合精度训练. 预训的时长不包括下游的微调. 完整的研究项目需要为初步实验、超参数扫描和未列入表格的失败运行进行额外计算。

blocks.en: For StreamMAE, a single H100 is sufficient, but we typically used 2 × 2\times H100 for WT++12h and 4 × 4\times H100 for longer streams to reduce turnaround time. On WT++12h , StreamMAE takes approximately 7 hours with ViT-S/16 and 8 hours with ViT-B/16 on 2 × 2\times H100, and scales roughly with pretraining stream duration. MoCo v3 and DINO on WT++12h take approximately 18 and 25 hours, respectively, on 2 × 2\times H100. For these runs, DataDrop is enabled with B = 2048 B=2048 , retaining 25 % 25\% of samples.
blocks.zh: 对于StreamMAE来说,一个H100就足够了,但我们通常使用2×2\times H100来表示WT++12h,4×4\times H100来表示更长的溪流以减少周转时间. 在WT++12h上,StreamMAE与VIT-S/16需要约7小时,与VIT-B/16在2×2\times H100上需要约8小时,而积分大致带有预训流持续时间. WT++12h上的MoCo v3和DINO分别需要大约18小时和25小时的时间,时间为2×2\times H100. 对于这些运行,DataDrop启用了B=2048 B=2048,保留25%的样本。

blocks.en: Downstream full fine-tuning on ImageNet-1K takes approximately 4 hours for ViT-S/16 and 5 hours for ViT-B/16 on 4 × 4\times H100. Semantic segmentation fine-tuning takes approximately 2 hours for ViT-S/16 and 2.5 hours for ViT-B/16 on a single H100. Depth fine-tuning takes approximately 3 hours on KITTI and 1.5 hours on NYUv2; reported depth metrics are mean ± \pm standard deviation over two fine-tuning runs with different seeds.
blocks.zh: 在ImageNet-1K上的下游全微调大约需要4小时的Vit-S/16和4×4\Times H100的Vit-B/16需要5小时. 语义分解微调需要约2小时的ViT-S/16和2.5小时的ViT-B/16单H100. 深度微调在KITTI上大约需要3小时,在NYUv2上大约需要1.5小时;所报告的深度度量度是平均值±\pm标准差,高于两个不同种子的微调运行.

blocks.zh: 表24: 估计计算要求。 WT++12h的预训时间报告,不包括下游微调.
